meta.gap_policy: No imputation. Exclude samples whose 8-week calendar feature window or next-week target crosses a missing week; expanding threshold uses observed past weeks only.

split.split_axis: distinct target weeks; all 17 cities share the same boundary

conclusion: Persistence clearly improves F1 over RF in this comparison.
